name: Crude stone altar
description: A crude altar of rough unhewn dark stone, about 1.5 m long, 0.9 m deep and 1 m high: two rough uprights packed with smaller stones under a thick lumpy capstone, its top and front streaked with old dark stains that ran down the faces and dried in a pool at its foot.
